name: Judy Moon and Associates, Massage Therapy

reviews.text:
I’ve been a returning client at Judy Moon and Associates since 2018. My go-to providers are Judy herself and Gwyn, who are both wonderful to work with.

I visit specifically for their Mindful Touch and Aromatherapy services, which always leave me feeling refreshed and rebalanced—especially when life gets hectic and I need a boost. I make it a point to book appointments a few times throughout the year, and I genuinely look forward to every visit.
reviews.author: Derek Ramoutar

reviews.text: Gotten massaged here a few times by Amanda when ive had back spasms/intense pain and she always made it so much better. She listens to adjustments in pressure well and does a great job creating a calming setting.
reviews.author: Noelle Riverol

reviews.text: I had a great experience at Judy Moon. The atmosphere and ambiance were great, and everything was so clean. I was seen promptly at my scheduled time. Gwyn was amazing! I went in for a prenatal massage at 33weeks and she worked on all of my problem areas amazingly. In my experience, many places that offer prenatal massages are apprehensive to apply a good amount of pressure, but Gwyn applied the perfect amount of pressure! After walking around in pain for weeks, I left feeling like a million bucks! I will definitely be returning very soon. Thank you, Gwyn.
reviews.author: Sarah Ajodhasingh

reviews.text:
Prenatal Massage (37 weeks)
I just left my massage with Gwyn and I couldn’t wait to write a review.
That was the best massage I’ve ever had.
First, before Gwyn even started, her expert positioning of my body and pillows to support my pregnant body was so skillfully done.
The intensity of pressure was perfect. She specifically focused on the areas I told her I was most concerned with.
The space is clean and peaceful.
Gwyn is magic
reviews.author: Eva Fitch

reviews.text:
I've been going here for a couple of years now and it is always the best massage. I go about a couple times a year for a little "treat yourself" moment. I've only ever booked with Dawn and she is absolutely amazing. It's crazy how she can tell exactly where you are hurt or tense and I leave like a relaxed blob of Jell-O every time. I'm sure the other massage therapists are wonderful as well.
Also the studio is a nice, clean, calming environment. It's also nice that they let you pick out whatever scent you're feeling that day for your massage oil.
They are also more reasonably priced compared to some massage studios in the city. That was one of the first reasons why I chose to go here besides the good reviews, which they definitely live up too.
reviews.author: Katy Adams
